io.milvus.v2.service.rbac

Class RBACService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.BaseService
      • io.milvus.v2.service.rbac.RBACService

  • public class RBACService
extends BaseService
    Service for role-based access control (RBAC) operations, including users, roles, privileges, and privilege groups.
